function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH q2 AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
  WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
),
cust AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customer_count FROM q2
),
gmv AS (
  SELECT sum(i.price + i.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM q2
  JOIN orders o USING(order_id)
  JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
)
SELECT cust.customer_count, gmv.gmv
FROM cust CROSS JOIN gmv;"}
